en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the woman sits in a seat and she stands up, so a man should not sit in her seat until it is cold’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And the Prophet<sup>asws</sup> was asked what the woman should adorn herself for the blind (husband). He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The perfume and the dye, for it is good aroma’.
en.sarwar: 38. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘A man must not sit in the seat of a woman who has just left it and it still has the warmth of her body.’
The Holy Prophet was asked about the beautification of a woman for a blind person. He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘It is perfumes and Henna because of the fineness of its whiff.’”
